lines.t: Restored
(Verse 1)
I’m going through many trials, and they seem like they’ll never end
When one is passed, another one comes, it’s as though they’re my friend
Oh Lord, please help me to embrace Your word
And help me to rely on what You said
(Verse 2)
Help me to remember what I have read
For a steadfast heart is made new
Lord, quiet my mind and restore my soul
And help me to dwell on You
(Pre-Chorus)
I surrender my will
Help me to be still
As I open myself up to You
(Chorus)
Like hidden treasure that’s been stored away
It’s now ready for You to view
So examine me well and don’t let me fail
For I want to be made brand new
Lord restore my soul and make me whole
For my heart belongs to You
(Bridge)
Help me open my heart
To get a new start
And shake off this residue
(Final Chorus)
Lord restore my soul and make me whole
For my heart belongs to You
(Final Chorus)
Lord restore my soul and make me whole
For my heart belongs to You
